about_the_game:
"LakeLady" is a click-and-solve puzzle AVG game based on the Unity engine.

In 2003, a child vanishes without a trace from Hongqiang Hospital, giving birth to the chilling legend of "The Lakelady" snatching children. Dr. Salvio, a surgeon investigating the case, uncovers a pattern of similar disappearances spanning five years – and a terrifying possibility that his own daughter was among the first victims. As he delves deeper into the hospital's dark secrets, he comes face-to-face with the real Lakelady, forcing the horrifying truth behind a catastrophic flood five years prior to surface.

Interact with over ten distinct characters, each harboring their own secrets and motives – from a lost young girl and an obsessed mother, to a childhood friend with hidden depths, and powerful figures with ambiguous agendas. Every character is a vital piece of the puzzle. Understand them, question them... or even become them.

  • Navigate a complex web of choices where paths intertwine and consequences ripple. Whether the resolution brings light or darkness remains unknown until the very end.

  • As Salvio, you possess both rational and emotional responses. Starting from Chapter 1, the information you uncover will dynamically shape Salvio's dialogue, attitude, and choices, steering the narrative towards vastly different branches and outcomes.

  • Experience intense escape sequences and terrifying talisman-based exorcisms. The carefully crafted horror serves to deepen your immersion in The Lakelady's unsettling world.

  • Puzzle details often hide narrative foreshadowing, making exploration rewarding. Step into Salvio's shoes for tense medical puzzles like brain tumor resection, liver trauma repair, or organ transplants – challenging but never unfairly obtuse.

  • Immerse yourself in a uniquely nostalgic early-2000s Southern Chinese setting. Feel the palpable humidity and find period authenticity in details like metal thermoses branded with the hospital name, orange public telephones, and white-grid sofa covers.

  • When the supernatural manifests, the game masterfully balances hauntingly grotesque and vividly colorful visuals. Combined with shifting musical scores and escalating tension, it creates an atmosphere of kaleidoscopic dread.

short_description: After his girlfriend died in a flood, the surgeon Salvio, in search of the truth behind his missing daughter, enters the "Ward No. 9" of Hongqiang Hospital, shrouded in the legend of the LakeLady.
